claims.text: Grace is identified as a theological structure that can maintain moral inconsistency and keep individuals stuck in shame rather than guiding them toward truth (L15).
In some instances, 'grace' is presented as a mechanism that can keep individuals from achieving personal growth by maintaining a sense of perpetual need or shame (L15).
It functions as a means of self-correction or compassion, particularly when the speaker acknowledges being harder on themselves than others (L3).
